Author: Raj Beer Singh

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5463 of 2023
Applicant :- Ashish Kumar

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Vinod Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Daya Shanker Pandey Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in case crime No. 616 of 2021, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Ecotech-3, District Gautam Budh Nagar with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant/accused that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

It was submitted that in her statement, under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., victim girl has clearly stated that she has gone with the applicant with her own free will and she has married with the applicant in a temple.
It was submitted that victim has lived with the applicant for about one year and they resided together as husband and wife.

Referring to the Exception provided in Section 375 I.P.C., it was submitted that sexual intercourse by a man with his Ashish Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151458982/
1 own wife, wife not being under 15 years of age, is not rape.

sentences.text: It was also submitted that no ossification test of victim girl has been conducted.
Referring to the facts of the matter, it was submitted that no case is made out against the applicant.

Lastly, it is submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 13.11.2022 and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and cooperate in the trial.

Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the first informant have opposed the prayer for bail and argued that victim was a 15 years old minor girl and she was taken away by the applicant and she was kept by him for one year.
There is no evidence to show that victim has married with the applicant.
Referring to the educational document of victim, it was submitted that at the time of incident, victim was only about 15 years old minor girl.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, gravity of offence and all attending facts and circumstances of case, the applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Hence, the bail application of applicant Ashish Kumar is hereby rejected.
